page_title: LEC 1-2 LAZ | Lecce v Lazio 21/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' Mohamed Kaba (Lecce) leaps high to meet a lofted pass inside the six-yard box, but his header only flies onto the left post and away off it.
90+4' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the left post.
90+4' Loum Tchaouna (Lazio) commits a foul during an attacking move.
90+2' Substitution. Nicola Sansone (Lecce) has come on for Gaby Jean.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
90' Having seen unsporting behavior, Gianluca Manganiello shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) is the recipient.

87' 1 - 2 The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Adam Marusic (Lazio) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner. His attempt was beyond the reach of Wladimiro Falcone. 1:2.
87' Pedro (Lazio) takes the corner with a short pass.
85' Pedro (Lazio) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
83' That's the end of the game for Mattia Zaccagni, who is replaced by Tijjani Noslin (Lazio).
83' Here is a change. Manuel Lazzari is going off and Marco Baroni gives the last tactical orders to Adam Marusic (Lazio).
82' Loum Tchaouna (Lazio) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Gianluca Manganiello ignores the protests.
80' Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
79' Substitution. Mohamed Kaba (Lecce) on for Medon Berisha.
79' Ante Rebic (Lecce) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
76' The Lazio players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
75' Pedro (Lazio) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
71' A yellow card for a tackle by Ante Rebic (Lecce). Gianluca Manganiello doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
70' Substitution. Nuno Tavares makes his way off the pitch and Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) comes on as his replacement.
70' Marco Baroni has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Loum Tchaouna (Lazio) replacing Gustav Isaksen.
70' Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) picks up a yellow card.
67' Pedro (Lazio) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
64' Substitution. Pedro (Lazio) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Boulaye Dia walks off.
64' Boulaye Dia (Lazio) has a goal ruled out for offside!
63' Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
60' Marco Giampaolo has decided to substitute Hamza Rafia and he is replaced by Balthazar Pierret (Lecce).
60' Here comes a substitution. Nikola Krstovic is given a rest as he is replaced by Ante Rebic (Lecce).
60' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
59' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
58' The ball is cleared after Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
57' The resulting corner from Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
54' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
53' Gianluca Manganiello blows his whistle and it's Taty Castellanos (Lazio) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.

50' 1 - 1 Goal! Tete Morente (Lecce) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a low shot into the bottom right corner. Ivan Provedel is unable to keep the ball out of the net. It's 1:1.
49' Lecce take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
48' The corner from Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) is cleared away by the defence.

47' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Lazio.
47' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Gianluca Manganiello saw the whole situation.
46' Referee Gianluca Manganiello blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' 0 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Taty Castellanos (Lazio) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Wladimiro Falcone no chance!
45+2' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) is going to take the penalty!
45+1' Frederic Guilbert (Lecce) is banished from the pitch as he receives a red card.
45+1' Frederic Guilbert (Lecce) probably handled the ball. PENALTY! One of the players from Lazio is about to take a penalty kick.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
44' Hamza Rafia (Lecce) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
44' Wladimiro Falcone (Lecce) picks up an injury.
43' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) hits an explosive shot from outside the penalty area and forces the goalkeeper to make a good save.
41' Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
40' A pass by Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
39' Hamza Rafia (Lecce) takes the corner kick, but Ivan Provedel reads it well and stops the effort.
38' Hamza Rafia (Lecce) fails to deliver a decent cross from a long-range free kick. The opposition's defence intercepts the effort.
37' Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle. Lecce earn a free kick.
37' Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
34' Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Wladimiro Falcone, who smothers the ball.
34' A lofted cross from Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
32' Medon Berisha (Lecce) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
32' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Hamza Rafia (Lecce). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
31' Hamza Rafia (Lecce) takes a short corner kick.

30' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the bottom right corner. Wladimiro Falcone guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
28' Tete Morente (Lecce) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.

26' A huge opportunity wasted! Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) produces a header from a rebound inside the six-yard box. His effort is denied by one of the defenders who is well positioned and clears the ball to safety.
25' Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) is unable to get the free-kick over the defensive wall from mid-range.

24' Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Lazio earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
22' Hamza Rafia (Lecce) plays a through ball which would have led to a great opportunity, if it hadn't been stopped by the defence.
21' Lazio seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
18' Medon Berisha (Lecce) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
17' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Wladimiro Falcone intercepts the ball.
16' Tete Morente (Lecce) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the top of the net, but Ivan Provedel has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
15' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Lecce.
14' The referee signals a corner kick to Lecce. Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) creates space for himself in the box and shoots, but the effort is unwittingly blocked by one of his own teammates.
13' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
11' Lecce failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
11' Frederic Guilbert (Lecce) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Lecce win a corner.
9' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) sends in a lofted cross from a long-range free kick in order to find one of his teammates. His poor effort, however, sails way out of play.
8' Rough tackle by Frederic Guilbert (Lecce). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. Lazio have a free kick.

7' Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the middle of the target, but Wladimiro Falcone was alert and the score remains the same.
4' Frederic Guilbert (Lecce) sends a long ball in, but Ivan Provedel comfortably gathers the ball.
2' Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Gianluca Manganiello blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The match has just started.
Lecce will kick the game off.
Gianluca Manganiello was nominated as the referee for this game.
